question: Does a packed-code full-bank direct finite-gallery success loss beat matched in-batch probability, full-bank log-count, and ArcFace controls on SOP train-only heldout products?
population: SOP official TRAIN 59,551 images; seed-179019 class-disjoint 53,700 fit images and 5,851 heldout images; no official test bytes
backbone: frozen authenticated pretrained UNICOM ViT-B/16@224 768-D features
head_and_wire: same centered fit-only PCA-initialized 768-to-128 affine head in all arms; normalize, round to signed int8, f16 inverse norm, 130 bytes per gallery row
schedule: 256 identical seed-179019 class-balanced 64-image batches, four images per identity; Adam head LR 0.0001, no weight decay; ArcFace proxy LR 0.0001; head gradient clip norm 1
loss_parameters: sigmoid score-difference temperature 0.03; direct success samples 5000/53700 of fit pool or proportional six of 63 in-batch rows; current-batch strongest positive; fit bank recomputed and detached every step; ArcFace margin 0.3 scale 64
readouts: packed Recall@1 and mAP@R on 5,851 heldout self-retrieval queries with 5,850 available heldout gallery rows, the same heldout queries against all 59,550 other train rows, and exact expected Recall@1 with 5,000 fit-pool rows sampled without replacement plus fixed heldout positives; report per-query vectors, training wall time, CUDA allocation and RSS
advance_gate: full-bank direct probability gains at least 1.0 percentage point full-train packed Recall@1 over in-batch direct probability, with product-identity bootstrap 95% interval excluding zero; no heldout-only Recall@1 regression; at least matches ArcFace full-train Recall@1; no official-test or SOTA claim from this screen
kill_conditions: a nonfinite loss, materially mismatched packed score arithmetic, direct probability tying log-count, or gains confined to fit-identity distractors without heldout-only nonregression
limitations: single seed, frozen backbone, all-fit gallery includes head-training identities, fixed temperature is a screen choice, no independent label-twin mask or official test read
